title: SpecUP Work Breakdown Structure
description: Canonical machine-readable WBS (specup.md s17). wbs.md is a generated view of this file and is never hand-maintained (s47).

level.description: Semantic level. MUST equal the number of dotted segments in the id. L1 Program/Product, L2 OpenUP Phase, L3 Iteration, L4 Capability/Feature, L5 Requirement/User Story, L6 Engineering Work Package, L7 Executable Task (s15).

parent.description: Exactly one parent, except the L1 root which has none (s18).

risks.description: Risks this node mitigates. A risk-mitigation node MUST reference at least one risk id (s18).

kind.description: Drives which conditional invariants apply. Levels 1-3 are always structural.

terminal_reason.description: Required when a leaf terminates above L7 under depth_policy 'semantic'. Records WHY further decomposition adds no value, so early termination stays a deliberate, reviewable act rather than an omission. Ignored under depth_policy 'strict'.

allOf.description: L7 executable tasks must be actionable: owner, iteration, and at least one requirement (s18, s32).
Risk-mitigation nodes must reference the risk they mitigate (s18, s19).
Test nodes must reference acceptance criteria (s18).
The L1 root has no parent; every other node has exactly one.

depth_policy.description: semantic (default): levels keep fixed meanings, a leaf may terminate above L7 if it declares terminal_reason. strict: specup.md s18 read literally - every leaf must be L7. Set project-wide in openup-config.yml; this field records what the file was authored against.

$comment: Graph-level invariants are NOT expressible in JSON Schema and are enforced by validate_wbs.py: (1) level == segment count of id; (2) parent id is the id minus its last segment, and that parent exists; (3) no cycles in parent/dependencies; (4) exactly one L1 root; (5) leaves are L7, or terminate earlier with terminal_reason under 'semantic'; (6) every referenced REQ/RISK/AC id resolves; (7) dependency targets exist and do not cross iterations backwards.
